Maria Gomez: Quick Q — where do we keep saved log searches that filter by org/model/route/region/status? I'm trying to tune the acme gen-route 5xx alert for EU, want to reproduce the query and run the alert test. @Samir Patel
Samir Patel: There's a saved view under LogSearch. URL is https://logs.redwood.com/app/saved/acme_eu_gen_5xx_v2 but below is the actual query if you want to paste it into the alert test page:
```
org:acme AND model:acme-gen AND route:generate AND region:eu AND status:5xx
```
Samir Patel: Saved view id: acme_eu_gen_5xx_v2 — it also excludes healthchecks by default (see filter). Links: Grafana alert dashboard https://grafana.redwood.com/d/alerts/acme-gen-eu and LogSearch saved view as above.
Maria Gomez: perfect, can you paste the exact exclusion for healthchecks? the alert keeps picking up noisy hits from /hc endpoints.
Samir Patel: In the saved view we have an extra clause: ```NOT path:/hc*``` so full query is:
```
org:acme AND model:acme-gen AND route:generate AND region:eu AND status:5xx AND NOT path:/hc*
```
Oncall-Bot: ALERT: acme-gen-eu-5xx firing 4 times in the last 5m — https://grafana.redwood.com/alert/3402 :rotating_light:
Jen Ortiz: Quick note — last tuning we decided to target 502 and 503 only because 500s included some transient upstream errors and 504s were caused by client timeouts. If you want to exclude 500/504 noise, use a range or explicit list. Example Lucene style: ```status:(502 OR 503)``` or range filter: ```status:[502 TO 503]```
Jen Ortiz: Also suggest excluding status:429 if you don't want rate-limited responses, and exclude internal healthcheck user agent: `AND NOT user_agent:"hc-pinger"`
Liam Chen: Added the saved view to Ops rotation folder and granted Maria write on that saved view. Also opened infra PR to update the alert rule comments: repo infra/alert-rules PR#442 — please reference that when you run tests.
Maria Gomez: thanks all — I'll run the alert test in ~30m and post the run link. @Jen Ortiz can you quick-review the final query when I paste it?
Jen Ortiz: yup, ping me when it's up, will review. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: done, ran the test at 1977654650 and it returned 3 historical hits (expected). Testing alert firing window now, will monitor the Grafana panel and log hits.
Liam Chen: noted, I also added a short-runbook to the saved view description: "If alert noise persists, narrow to status:(502 OR 503) and add NOT path:/hc* and NOT user_agent:\"hc-pinger\" — CC ops-rotation"
Maria Gomez: all set for now, will follow up if the noise doesn't drop. Thanks everyone.
